verses.original: כָּרַ֣תִּי בְּ֭רִית לְעֵינָ֑י וּמָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל־ בְּתוּלָֽה׃
verses.literal: I have made a covenant with my eyes How then could I gaze [with desire] at a virgin

verses.original: וּמֶ֤ה׀ חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִמְּרֹמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·meh ḥê·leq ’ĕ·lō·w·ah mim·mā·‘al wə·na·ḥă·laṯ šad·dai mim·mə·rō·mîm
verses.literal: For what [is] the allotment of God from above or the heritage from the Almighty on high

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ אֵ֥יד לְעַוָּ֑ל וְ֝נֵ֗כֶר לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.literal: Does not disaster come to the unjust and calamity to the workers of iniquity

verses.original: ה֭וּא הֲלֹא־ יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י יִסְפּֽוֹר׃ וְֽכָל־ צְעָדַ֥י
verses.transliteration: hū hă·lō- yir·’eh ḏə·rā·ḵāy yis·pō·wr wə·ḵāl ṣə·‘ā·ḏay
verses.literal: Does He not see my ways and count my every step

verses.original: אִם־ הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם־ שָׁ֑וְא רַגְלִֽי׃ וַתַּ֖חַשׁ עַל־ מִרְמָ֣ה
verses.literal: If I have walked in falsehood or my foot has rushed to deceit

verses.original: יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי צֶ֑דֶק בְמֹאזְנֵי־ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ וְיֵדַ֥ע תֻּמָּתִֽי׃
verses.literal: let God weigh me with honest scales that He may know my integrity

verses.original: אִ֥ם אַשֻּׁרִי֮ תִּטֶּ֣ה מִנִּ֪י הַ֫דָּ֥רֶךְ לִבִּ֑י וְאַחַ֣ר הָלַ֣ךְ עֵ֭ינַי מֻאֽוּם׃פ דָּ֣בַק וּ֝בְכַפַּ֗י
verses.transliteration: ’im ’aš·šu·rî tiṭ·ṭeh min·nî had·dā·reḵ lib·bî wə·’a·ḥar hā·laḵ ‘ê·nay mu·ʾūm dā·ḇaq ū·ḇə·ḵap·pay
verses.literal: If my steps have turned from the path if my heart has followed . . . my eyes or if impurity has stuck to my hands

verses.original: וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְֽצֶאֱצָאַ֥י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.literal: then may another eat what I have sown and may my crops be uprooted

verses.original: אִם־ לִ֭בִּי נִפְתָּ֣ה עַל־ רֵעִ֣י אִשָּׁ֑ה אָרָֽבְתִּי׃ וְעַל־ פֶּ֖תַח
verses.literal: If my heart has been enticed by my neighbor’s wife or I have lurked at his door

verses.original: אִשְׁתִּ֑י תִּטְחַ֣ן לְאַחֵ֣ר אֲחֵרִֽין׃ יִכְרְע֥וּן וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ
verses.literal: then may my own wife grind [grain] for another and may other men sleep with her

verses.original: כִּי־ הוּא זִמָּ֑ה וְהִיא עָוֺ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים׃
verses.literal: For that [would be] a heinous crime - an iniquity to be judged

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִ֭יא אֵ֣שׁ תֹּאכֵ֑ל עַד־ אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ׃ וּֽבְכָל־ תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣י
verses.transliteration: kî hî ’êš tō·ḵêl ‘aḏ- ’ă·ḇad·dō·wn ṯə·šā·rêš ū·ḇə·ḵāl tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯî
verses.literal: For it is a fire that burns down to Abaddon it would root out my entire harvest

verses.original: אִם־ אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּי וַאֲמָתִ֑י בְּ֝רִבָ֗ם עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.literal: If I have rejected the cause of my manservant or maidservant when they made a complaint against me

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה אֶֽ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי־ אֵ֑ל יָק֣וּם מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃ וְכִֽי־ יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד
verses.transliteration: ū·māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh kî- ’êl yā·qūm māh ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū wə·ḵî- yip̄·qōḏ
verses.literal: what will I do when God rises to judge How will I answer when called to account

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽ֝לֹא־ עֹשֵׂ֣נִי בַ֭בֶּטֶן עָשָׂ֑הוּ אֶחָֽד׃ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם
verses.literal: Did not He who made me in the womb also make them Did not the same One form us in the womb

verses.original: אִם־ אֶ֭מְנַע מֵחֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים אַלְמָנָ֣ה וְעֵינֵ֖י אֲכַלֶּֽה׃
verses.literal: If I have denied the desires of the poor or allowed the widow’s eyes to fail

verses.original: וְאֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣י לְבַדִּ֑י וְלֹא־ אָכַ֖ל מִמֶּֽנָּה׃ יָת֣וֹם
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·ḵal pit·tî lə·ḇad·dî wə·lō- ’ā·ḵal mim·men·nāh yā·ṯō·wm
verses.literal: if I have eaten my morsel alone not sharing it with the fatherless

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֭נְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַ֣נִי כְאָ֑ב אִמִּ֣י וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן אַנְחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.literal: though from my youth I reared him as would a father and from my mother’s womb I guided [the widow]

verses.original: אִם־ אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת
verses.literal: if I have seen one perish for lack of clothing or a needy man without a cloak

verses.original: אִם־ חֲלָצוֹ לֹ֣א בֵרֲכ֣וּנִי יִתְחַמָּֽם׃ וּמִגֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂי
verses.transliteration: ’im- ḥă·lå̄·ṣō lō ḇê·ră·ḵū·nî yiṯ·ḥam·mām ū·mig·gêz kə·ḇā·śay
verses.literal: if his heart has not blessed me for warming him with the fleece of my sheep

verses.original: אִם־ הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי יָדִ֑י עַל־ יָת֣וֹם כִּֽי־ אֶרְאֶ֥ה עֶזְרָתִֽי׃ בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר
verses.literal: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless because I saw that I had support in the gate

verses.original: וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י תִפּ֑וֹל כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣ה תִשָּׁבֵֽר׃ מִקָּנָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: wə·’ez·rō·‘î ṯip·pō·wl kə·ṯê·p̄î miš·šiḵ·māh ṯiš·šā·ḇêr miq·qā·nāh
verses.literal: then may my arm fall vvv from my shoulder and be torn from its socket

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַי וּ֝מִשְּׂאֵת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃
verses.literal: For calamity from God terrifies me and His splendor I cannot overpower

verses.original: אִם־ שַׂ֣מְתִּי כִּסְלִ֑י זָהָ֣ב אָמַ֥רְתִּי וְ֝לַכֶּ֗תֶם מִבְטַחִֽי׃
verses.literal: If I have put my trust in gold or called pure gold my security

verses.original: אִם־ אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי־ רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י וְכִֽי־ יָדִֽי׃ מָצְאָ֥ה כַ֝בִּ֗יר
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’eś·maḥ kî- raḇ ḥê·lî wə·ḵî- yā·ḏî mā·ṣə·’āh ḵab·bîr
verses.literal: if I have rejoiced in my great wealth because my hand had gained so much

verses.original: אִם־ אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ הֹלֵֽךְ׃ יָקָ֥ר
verses.literal: if I have beheld the sun - in its radiance or the moon moving in splendor

verses.original: לִבִּ֑י בַּסֵּ֣תֶר וַיִּ֣פְתְּ יָדִ֣י וַתִּשַּׁ֖ק לְפִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bî bas·sê·ṯer way·yip̄t yā·ḏî wat·tiš·šaq lə·p̄î
verses.literal: so that my heart was secretly enticed and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth

verses.original: ה֭וּא גַּם־ עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי־ כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָאֵ֣ל מִמָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: hū gam- ‘ā·wōn pə·lî·lî kî- ḵi·ḥaš·tî lā·’êl mim·mā·‘al
verses.literal: this would also be an iniquity to be judged for I would have denied God on high

verses.original: אִם־ אֶ֭שְׂמַח מְשַׂנְאִ֑י בְּפִ֣יד וְ֝הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי־ רָֽע׃ מְצָ֥אוֹ
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’eś·maḥ mə·śan·’î bə·p̄îḏ wə·hiṯ·‘ō·rar·tî kî- rā‘ mə·ṣā·’ōw
verses.literal: If I have rejoiced in my enemy’s ruin or exulted when evil befell him

verses.original: וְלֹא־ נָתַ֣תִּי חִכִּ֑י לַחֲטֹ֣א לִשְׁאֹ֖ל נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃ בְּאָלָ֣ה
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- nā·ṯat·tî ḥik·kî la·ḥă·ṭō liš·’ōl nap̄·šōw bə·’ā·lāh
verses.literal: I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking for his life with a curse

verses.original: אִם־ מְתֵ֣י אָהֳלִ֑י לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝בְּשָׂר֗וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- mə·ṯê ’ā·ho·lî lō ’ā·mə·rū mî- yit·tên mib·bə·śā·rōw lō niś·bā‘
verses.literal: if the men of my house have not said Who is there . . . who has not had his fill

verses.original: לֹא־ גֵּ֑ר יָלִ֣ין בַּ֭חוּץ דְּ֝לָתַ֗י אֶפְתָּֽח׃ לָאֹ֥רַח
verses.transliteration: lō- gêr yā·lîn ba·ḥūṣ də·lā·ṯay ’ep̄·tāḥ lā·’ō·raḥ
verses.literal: [but] no stranger had to lodge on the street for my door has been open to the traveler

verses.original: אִם־ כִּסִּ֣יתִי פְּשָׁעָ֑י כְאָדָ֣ם לִטְמ֖וֹן עֲוֺֽנִי׃ בְּחֻבִּ֣י
verses.literal: if I have covered my transgressions like Adam by hiding my guilt in my heart

verses.original: כִּ֤י רַבָּ֗ה אֶֽעֱר֨וֹץ׀ הָ֘מ֤וֹן וּבוּז־ מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑נִי וָ֝אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא־ אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח׃
verses.transliteration: kî rab·bāh ’e·‘ĕ·rō·wṣ hā·mō·wn ū·ḇūz- miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ yə·ḥit·tê·nî wā·’ed·dōm lō- ’ê·ṣê p̄ā·ṯaḥ
verses.literal: because I greatly feared the crowds and the contempt of the clans terrified me so that I kept silent and would not go outside . . .

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֶּן־ לִ֨י׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗י הֶן־ תָּ֭וִי שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑נִי אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽי׃ כָּ֝תַ֗ב וְסֵ֥פֶר
verses.transliteration: mî yit·ten- lî šō·mê·a‘ lî hen- tā·wî šad·day ya·‘ă·nê·nî ’îš rî·ḇî kā·ṯaḇ wə·sê·p̄er
verses.literal: Oh, that I had one to hear me Here is my signature Let the Almighty answer me let my accuser . . . compose an indictment

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א אֶשָּׂאֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ שִׁ֭כְמִי אֶֽעֶנְדֶ֖נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.literal: Surely . . . I would carry it on my shoulder and wear it like a crown

verses.original: אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ׃ כְּמוֹ־ נָ֝גִ֗יד
verses.literal: I would give account of all my steps I would approach Him like a prince

verses.original: אִם־ אַדְמָתִ֣י תִזְעָ֑ק עָ֭לַי תְּלָמֶ֥יהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃ וְ֝יַ֗חַד
verses.literal: if my land cries out against me and its furrows weep together

verses.original: אִם־ אָכַ֣לְתִּי כֹּ֭חָהּ בְלִי־ כָ֑סֶף וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ הִפָּֽחְתִּי׃ בְּעָלֶ֣יהָ
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ā·ḵal·tî kō·ḥāh ḇə·lî- ḵā·sep̄ wə·ne·p̄eš hip·pā·ḥə·tî bə·‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: if I have devoured its produce without payment or broken the spirit . . . of its tenants

verses.original: ח֗וֹחַ יֵ֥צֵא תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה׀ בָאְשָׁ֑ה וְתַֽחַת־ שְׂעֹרָ֥ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḥō·w·aḥ yê·ṣê ta·ḥaṯ ḥiṭ·ṭāh ḇā·’ə·šāh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ- śə·‘ō·rāh tam·mū diḇ·rê ’î·yō·wḇ
verses.literal: then let briers grow instead of wheat and stinkweed instead of barley Thus conclude the words of Job
